lines.text: A great multitude in heaven shouts Hallelujah because God has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth.
The elders and living creatures worship God, and a voice from the throne calls all who serve Him to praise.
A great multitude declares that the Lord reigns, and the Lamb's bride is given clothing of purple, bright and pure.
The angel says to write that those invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb are blessed.
The angel stops the worship, saying he is a fellow servant who relies on the testimony of Moses.
